[A10] BOUNDED CORRECTION ASSIGNMENT

A175 Codex takes a bounded documentation correction slot alongside A176 on #517, using capacity released by the unavailable Opus review. This is a recorded scheduling change from the earlier serial author plan. Each branch/worktree has one author, CPU sets are distinct, and the correction does not run a full native bank. Fix R239-1 F1/F2/F3 under their original MINOR Docs assignments, using the published measured reset/past semantics and actual witness grading. The existing issue-linked branch remains372-bound-axis-assertions; start at60c5225f. Restrict edits to the assertion guide, testing/suite index summaries and the inaccurate harness-header comment. No checker, stimulus, scoreboard, campaign, count, parser, Makefile, RTL, processor pin or optional suggestion changes. The corrected header is a Tests/Robustness artifact, so those lenses must be re-covered as R239 requires. R240 supplies the independent internal Codex review for the correction; R239 supplies the external Opus review when available. No earlier positive is carried over blindly. The old local replica is cancelled and terminal, the PR is draft, and no review is in flight for this source. Source stays local until manager validation.
